summary: This paper establishes three exact structural theorems governing the Cesàro average mixing matrix and generalized uniform average mixing (UAM) of continuous-time quantum walks on primitive strongly regular graphs SRG(n,k,lambda,mu). First, it proves that the Cesàro average mixing matrix M-bar is strictly rational and obeys the unconditional return barrier M_uu = (1 + m_r^2 + m_s^2)/n^2 >= (n^2 - 2n + 3)/(2n^2) > 1/n, with equality if and only if G is a conference graph, while deriving the closed-form off-diagonal imbalance law. Second, it solves the Diophantine condition for non-conference off-diagonal Cesàro uniformity, discovering an infinite polynomial parameter family n(t) = (t+1)(4t+1)^2 anchored at t=2 by the ternary Golay dual coset graph SRG(243, 110, 37, 60) and classifying all solutions up to n <= 1200. Third, it proves via affine moment-line polytope analysis that every member of the infinite t-family has an empty polytope intersection (max c_1 <= -12 < -1), proving unconditionally that off-diagonal Cesàro uniformity does not imply UAM, while contrasting this with exact 16x16 Hadamard-involution IUM on Clebsch, L2(4), and Shrikhande.

Rigorous proof that off-diagonal Cesàro uniformity does not imply uniform average mixing (UAM) via moment-line polytope empty intersection across the entire t-family.
